title: Copley Formal Lounge

blurb: Copley Formal Lounge, formerly known as the Copley Senior Reading Lounge, was constructed in 1930 as part of Copley Hall. The namesake of Copley Hall and Lounge is Father Thomas Copley, S.J., an early missionary in Maryland and a potential relative of Queen Elizabeth. Copley Lounge, alongside Copley Hall, officially opened to Georgetown students on February 16th, 1931.
